I don't think photos really do this head sculpt justice. It's one that's easier to appreciate in person to see that half baked expression with the hazy eyes and crooked smile.
Getting Riddle's submission moves executed properly is a challenge thanks to the single jointed elbows — this is an area Mattel might need to address beyond the Ultimate Edition figures soon.
The highlight is his cloth jacket. It's tailored properly and is a good fit with clean applications of the logos.
He also has his headband, which actually has a great paintjob.
Finally, he's got his flip flops — fling off action feature not included.
